messages:
Maria (Support): FYI — high-touch enterprise ask from AcmeCorp. They want SSO + SCIM provisioning, a Terraform provider example for IaC, and JS + Python SDK snippets for marketplace. Ticket: https://zendesk.example/12345
Alicia (Product): thanks for the heads up. Do they need full SCIM provisioning (create/patch/group sync) or just one-way import? timeline? :calendar:
Maria (Support): full provisioning + group sync. Audit logs required. Customer wants onboarding in ~8 weeks but will negotiate if scope reduced.
Tara (Solutions): context: customer runs Dedicated in VPC with KMS. They want terraform to provision the connector and outputs we can reference in console. Also want RBAC templates.
Jordan (Eng): quick feasibility notes: SCIM + OIDC SSO is doable, but for Private we must support a SCIM relay or allow inbound from our control plane — both add complexity. Rough ballpark: 3–4w for core SCIM endpoints + 2w for audit/ops and tests.
Sam (SDK): SDK-side: current JS/py libs support token auth. We need OIDC helper flows + example usage patterns for provisioning. Estimate ~1 week per language for examples/tests.
Alicia (Product): proposed MVP scope to hit sooner: (1) OIDC SSO docs + sample config, (2) SCIM user create/patch/suspend + basic group sync, (3) Terraform module that wires connector provisioning and exports necessary outputs, (4) SDK examples + marketplace checklist. Exclude HSM/KMS deep integrations and advanced audit forwarding for now.
Jordan (Eng): agree. Add rollout/launch criteria: end-to-end smoke in a Dedicated demo tenant, automated SCIM integration test, security review signoff, and ops playbook (oncall runbook + rollback plan).
Tara (Solutions): tagging request for backlog: cust-AcmeCorp, cust-ask, integration:scim, integration:sso, integration:terraform, priority:high, okr:Q2. Also recommend adding a short customer scoping form for pre-sales.
Alicia (Product): I'll file the backlog ticket and set up grooming. Action items: @Jordan - break down engineering tasks + estimates by EOD Thu; @Sam - prepare JS/py snippets + tests; @Tara - draft scoping doc and marketplace checklist; @Maria - keep customer updated and confirm compliance must-haves. :white_check_mark:
Jordan (Eng): will do. Example SCIM request to validate format for SDK docs:
```
POST /scim/v2/Users
Authorization: Bearer <token>
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "userName": "jli",
  "name": {"givenName": "Jun", "familyName": "Li"},
  "emails": [{"value": "jli@acme.com"}]
}
```
Sam (SDK): I'll add JS and Python snippets and a short integration test that hits a local SCIM mock. Also adding a PR checklist item: "marketplace-ready examples + terraform module included".
deploy-bot: Created ticket RW-5421 in product-backlog with labels: cust-AcmeCorp, integration:scim, integration:sso, integration:terraform, priority:high
Alicia (Product): Great, scheduling grooming session Thu 10:00am PT. Please bring final estimates and any blocker items.
Maria (Support): I'll confirm customer flexibility on timeline and follow up with compliance documentation request.
Jordan (Eng): noted — will surface any infra gating items in the ticket.
